status: EXPERIMENT BASE (WP3 exp v2). Prompts written once from the v1 aggregate error report; per-field prompt-set choice and per-value logit offsets are tuned per cross-fold in data/smoke_vnext/wp3_n10_v1/exp_v2/config_v2_tuned_fold*.json (tools/vnext_wp3_exp_v2.py). Not a production config.

scoring.phrasing_aggregation: same as v1 (mean of L2-normalised phrasings per sub-concept)
scoring.value_logit: max over the value's sub-concepts of logit_scale*cos+logit_bias, PLUS value_logit_offsets[field][value] (default 0; tuned per fold)
scoring.prompt_set: per field, prompt_set_choice in {v1, v2, union}: v1 = config v1 sub-concepts, v2 = this file's sub-concepts, union = both (max over all sub-concepts)

decision.scope: as v1, but unreadable_or_blank is decided ONLY by the pixel blank_rule (SigLIP 'unreadable' sub-concepts are removed from the reject competition): in_scope=true iff blank_rule false AND logit(in_scope)+offset >= max(SigLIP reject logits)+offset - scope_reject_logit_margin

blank_rule.rule: unreadable_or_blank iff gray std (0-255, 384px) <= gray_std_max AND mean |dx|+|dy| gradient <= edge_mean_max (near-constant image only)
blank_rule.revision_note: first draft used OR with 6.0/1.0 and fired on 2 white-background product shots (idx 35, 38; gold isolated_product) -> tightened to AND 2.0/0.3 before the reported runs; fires on 0 of 225 now

decision.unknown_note: v2 disables the v1 'unknown' floor (0.35) for scoring: gold never uses unknown, so unknown is always counted wrong; uncertainty is reported as margin for routing instead

cover: identical to v1 (tier rule + mean-of-components score)
